title: My Motor Island Official Website
text: My Motor Island brought Road Rippers toys into a virtual world for children. I contributed Flash development to the experience. Players encountered the brand’s vehicles in a digital setting, extending the toys beyond physical play. The project was a way to bring Toy State’s vehicle lights, sounds, and actions online. The result was a playable destination built around the Road Rippers brand.
summary: I contributed Flash development to My Motor Island, a virtual world that brought Road Rippers toy cars into an online setting for children to explore.
